hints.label: nudge
hints.text: The container is not slow or unhealthy by accident; it is being started again and again. Ask why the process ends each time it starts.

hints.label: pointer to the signal
hints.text: Read `docker compose ps` (state and restart count), then `docker compose logs web` and `docker inspect` (State.ExitCode, Config.Env). The exit code and the first log line say what the process objected to.

hints.label: near-solution
hints.text: The service validates its WORKERS environment variable and exits with code 2 when it is not an integer. Fix the value in docker-compose.yml. Do not remove the restart policy, override the command, or make the code accept garbage.
